risks.risk: Lens may have fungus/haze/scratches or poor focus/VR issues not visible in these photos.

risks.risk: Camera may have shutter wear, dead pixels, or sensor dust not visible here.
risks.proof: Provide a live-view shot of a blank wall at high ISO (e.g., ISO 3200) and a shutter count screenshot (or EXIF/utility output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: unknown shutter count and possible sensor dust.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/battery/charger or non-original items (box shown, but contents not shown).

risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: incomplete kit (only body+lens).

risks.risk: Box label may not match the actual lens/camera condition (photos show kit branding, but not verification of exact lens version beyond label).
risks.proof: Photo of the lens mount/side label with full model text and serial/VR marking, plus a photo of the camera model plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: mismatch/uncertain exact kit configuration.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements (under bright light) to check fungus/haze/scratches.
A short video showing autofocus hunting/lock and VR behavior (turn VR on/off).
Live-view test photo of a plain wall at high ISO to reveal sensor dust/dead pixels.
Shutter count screenshot (or EXIF/utility output) and a photo of the battery/charger included.
Photo of all accessories included laid out clearly.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Nikon D3300 with an 18-55mm VR II kit box, but they do not verify key condition factors (lens optics/VR, shutter count, sensor health) that strongly affect the resale price in Lagos. Without those proofs, only a worst-case condition pricing would be safe.
